datasets.name: top_10_products
queryLines:
SELECT
  product,
  SUM(revenue) as revenue
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      p.product,
      SUM(f.sold_quantity * pr.price_inr) as revenue
    FROM
      atlone_enterprise.gold.parent_fact_orders f
        LEFT JOIN atlone_enterprise.gold.parent_dim_products p
          ON f.product_code = p.product_code
        LEFT JOIN atlone_enterprise.gold.parent_dim_gross_price pr
          ON f.product_code = pr.product_code
    GROUP BY
      p.product
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      p.product,
      SUM(f.sold_quantity * pr.gross_price) as revenue
    FROM
      atlone_enterprise.gold.child_fact_orders f
        LEFT JOIN atlone_enterprise.gold.child_dim_products p
          ON f.product_code = p.product_code
        LEFT JOIN atlone_enterprise.gold.child_dim_gross_price pr
          ON f.product_code = pr.product_code
    GROUP BY
      p.product
  ) combined
GROUP BY
  product
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: growth_analysis
queryLines:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', date) as month_date,
    SUM(revenue) as monthly_revenue,
    LAG(SUM(revenue), 1) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', date)) as prev_month_revenue,
    LAG(SUM(revenue), 12) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', date)) as prev_year_revenue
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        f.date,
        (f.sold_quantity * pr.price_inr) AS revenue
      FROM
        atlone_enterprise.gold.parent_fact_orders f
          LEFT JOIN atlone_enterprise.gold.parent_dim_gross_price pr
            ON f.product_code = pr.product_code
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        f.date,
        (f.sold_quantity * pr.gross_price) AS revenue
      FROM
        atlone_enterprise.gold.child_fact_orders f
          LEFT JOIN atlone_enterprise.gold.child_dim_gross_price pr
            ON f.product_code = pr.product_code
    )
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', date)
)
SELECT
  month_date,
  monthly_revenue,
  prev_month_revenue,
  prev_year_revenue,
  ROUND(
    ((monthly_revenue - prev_month_revenue) / NULLIF(prev_month_revenue, 0)) * 100,
    2
  ) as mom_growth_pct,
  ROUND(
    ((monthly_revenue - prev_year_revenue) / NULLIF(prev_year_revenue, 0)) * 100,
    2
  ) as yoy_growth_pct
FROM
  monthly_revenue
ORDER BY
  month_date
